title: liparis decurrens
intro: Liparis decurrens, commonly known as the liparis root, is a plant species belonging to the family Orchidaceae. It is a type of orchid native to Asia, traditionally used in folk medicine for its therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Liparis decurrens include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Liparis decurrens include flavonoids and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
